title: longfellow-vectors shared value shapes, v1
description: Definitions referenced by the per-type vector schemas. Not a vector schema; no sidecar names this file in its `schema` field.

hex.description: Byte string as an even, positive number of lowercase hex digits.

sha256hex.description: SHA-256 digest as 64 lowercase hex digits.

p256coordinate.description: P-256 affine coordinate as 64 lowercase hex digits, left-padded with zeros.

p256scalar.description: P-256 private scalar as 64 lowercase hex digits, left-padded with zeros.

repo.description: Source repository as host/owner/name, e.g. github.com/google/longfellow-zk.

ref.description: Full commit hash the bytes were captured at.

path.description: Path of the source artifact within the repository at ref.

index.description: Position within the source artifact when the bytes are one of several it holds, e.g. mdoc_tests[15].

via.description: Intermediate artifact the bytes passed through, when not captured directly.

captured.description: Date the bytes were copied out of the source, as YYYY-MM-DD.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the source's license, recorded when that license requires copied bytes to carry its terms, e.g. MPL-2.0.

copyright.description: Copyright notice retained from the source, e.g. Copyright 2025 ISRG.

generator.description: The generating command as run, e.g. generate_vectors.py flip-bit --proof <name> --byte 3. The command line states what was run; it reproduces the bytes only for a deterministic mode.

ref.description: Full commit hash of the generator at generation time.

created.description: Date the bytes were generated, as YYYY-MM-DD.
